acceptance.finite: Both actual and reference must be finite in every element, for both outputs.
acceptance.alias: Returned tensor must alias the original supplied out storage/view; evaluate that original destination. The original implementation returns the same out object. Do not repair missing writes by copying the returned tensor into out.
acceptance.out_poison: Fill the supplied out with BF16 NaN before the evaluated call, without replacing its object or storage. Re-poison after native-launcher preparation and outside measured time; original torch.empty generation remains unchanged.
acceptance.checks: Compare all read-only input bytes before/after; retain original out allocation/view metadata, check complete overwrite, shape/dtype and alias. Workspace is scratch, not a semantic output or read-only input. Use an independent reference destination and do not let reference overwrite candidate evidence.
acceptance.complete_executable_evaluator_status: missing K8 integration, not missing numerical helper source: historical harness.py has checks/poison/unchanged and post-call data_ptr alias checks. It does not bind pre-call original out storage/view and its post-timing path checks returned values only; a fixed F1 Task/evaluator/source adapter and full cold/steady boundary still require implementation and qualification.

dispatch.schema_when: q_len_per_req=4; 1<=batchcount<=17; 4<=max_seq_len<=256; each seq_lens>=4; fixed splitcount=1 and direct output. Steady native cache hit: same objects/signature, thread/current device, outside stream capture.
dispatch.root_binding: reject: root requires Q4/B15-or-16/L>=24576/S9; it is not a fallback. Any Q1-to-root binding also fails Q=4.
dispatch.effective: Use root CONTRACT plus q4_direct local DESIGN and REALIZATION. Retain raw root/direct and actual dispatch bytes; effective output does not replace raw Schema.
dispatch.task_uncovered: All shared-Contract inputs except this one fixed point; no claim over full q4_direct, Q1, cluster, global or compact variants.

timing_boundary.cold_start: Record fresh process/module preparation, compilation, normal fmha call, native FFI probe, device synchronization and possible out restore separately. No cold-start measurement has been made.
timing_boundary.native_probe: delta/denominator if denominator > 1e-6 else delta, then <= 1e-2; this is only the native replay probe, never the Task comparator.
timing_boundary.steady: Only after launcher eligibility is demonstrated, time the complete Model.forward call and completion on the same objects/signature/thread/device outside capture. Preserve raw samples and recipe in K8; do not substitute kernel-sum or omit required host/combine work.
timing_boundary.poison_placement: Initial input construction, poisoning and reference evaluation are outside timing. Reuse the original six tensor objects through warmup/measurement; keep seed, values and block mapping fixed.

remaining_fidelity_obligations: N=1 initializes and consumes empty sum/numerator parity
TMA handles padded pages and page tail correctly; the first four logical page indices include unused -1 entries

full source-to-current-Schema fidelity including FP8 hi/lo, FP32 denominator and required primitives
